title: Build an HTTP request step by step
description: HttpRequest is an immutable object that needs a method and URL at minimum, plus optional headers and a body. A skeleton HttpRequestBuilder exists but its setter methods and build() are unimplemented. Fill them in so callers can configure a builder and get a valid HttpRequest back.
hints: Each setter should just store the value — no need to return anything
build() should throw IllegalStateException if method or url is null or blank
HttpRequest is a plain data class — you don't need to change it
issues: Constructing an HttpRequest with many optional fields leads to telescoping constructors or a bloated parameter list
There is no validation step before the object is handed to callers
overallGoal: Use the Builder pattern to construct an HttpRequest incrementally, validating required fields only at build() time and keeping HttpRequest itself immutable.
goals: Implement each setter on HttpRequestBuilder to store the given value
In build(), throw IllegalStateException if method or url has not been set
In build(), construct and return a fully populated HttpRequest
